389:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm not some surprise box with a glamorous beauty inside, like that one.」

389:t_10:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Exactly, $n. Don't go having any indecent fantasies about me.」

389:t_10:19.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A-ah... Please spare me the $$ブーストアップ$$ punishment...!」

389:t_10:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...I'm glad for you, $$メール$$. $$ランド$$ and $$ガンレオン$$ made it over the wall.」

389:t_10:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「For all your devoted work backing him up from behind the scenes, $$メール$$, please allow me to present you with this.」

389:t_10:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's right. With these, even you, $$メール$$, will be able to stand up to $$エルーナルーナ$$.」

389:t_10:29.en:
$$メール$$
「I get it! I pop the balloons right in front of the enemy, and attack while they're startled, right!」

389:t_10:31.en:
$$メール$$
「I'll go put them on $$ガンレオン$$ right away. Thanks, $$ＡＧ$$!」

389:t_10:33.en:
$$メール$$
「Oh, sorry! I forgot something important!」

389:t_10:34.en:
$$メール$$
「Let's give it our all again today!」

389:t_10:39.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Making $$メール$$ cry is not something I will allow, $$ランド$$...」

390:t_000:0.en:
$$オットー$$
「All units, are you ready!? Our opponent is $$ストラウス$$, the Empire's Supreme Commander!」

390:t_000:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「If we can hit her hard here, $$オペレーション・エクリプス$$ will speed up all at once!」

390:t_000:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You're fired up, Captain $$オットー$$.」

390:t_000:3.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Yes... It's as if he were a different person.」

390:t_000:4.en:
$$カツ$$
「Major $$コンロイ$$, do you have any idea what's behind the Captain's change?」

390:t_000:5.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「Nothing! The Captain is the same as always!」

390:t_000:7.en:
$$メール$$
「How about Darling? Did $$クロウ$$'s special training change anything?」

390:t_000:8.en:
$$ランド$$
「Yeah, sort of... For now, I got a good long taste of stress.」

390:t_000:9.en:
$$セツコ$$
「A-Are you all right? You look like a completely different person.」

390:t_000:10.en:
$$クロウ$$
「No risk, no return... Grasping something is hard, isn't it.」

390:t_000:11.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Well, the 1-million-G man does have a way with words.」

390:t_000:12.en:
$$青山$$
「Quite right. Those are truly words worth 1 million G.」

390:t_000:13.en:
$$ランド$$
「...I'll hold this against you, $$クロウ$$.」

390:t_000:16.en:
$$スザク$$
「It's the reverse of the usual roles.」

390:t_000:17.en:
$$シン$$
「Still, if even $$ランド$$ can't manage a smile, it must have been some seriously brutal training.」

390:t_000:18.en:
$$キラ$$
「Why don't you give it a try too, $$シン$$?」

390:t_000:19.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「Please don't, $$キラ$$! $$シン$$'s scowl is so fierce it's not even funny!」

390:t_000:20.en:
$$宗介$$
「Perfect timing. We'll have him fill the vacancy in the Quiet Five.」

390:t_000:21.en:
$$カイエン$$
「Indeed. If $$アマタ$$ took that training too, his face would firm up a little.」

390:t_000:22.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Ha ha, ha ha... No thanks.」

390:t_000:23.en:
$$ランド$$
「Ah, to be young. Being able to relax even in a pinch like this.」

390:t_000:24.en:
$$メール$$
「You sound kind of like an old man, Darling.」

390:t_001:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「Let's do this, $$メール$$! It's too early for me to be going over to the other side!」

390:t_001:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Push him and he pushes back... No wonder, after coming through Mission Spring.」

390:t_001:5.en:
$$デュオ$$
「This is no time to be playing around! Here they come!」

390:t_002:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「So you came, $$ストラウス$$!」

390:t_002:5.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Somehow, people who wear masks always come full circle and end up promoting themselves like crazy.」

390:t_002:6.en:
$$カレン$$
「Then that... is like a declaration of war before the battle!?」

390:t_002:8.en:
$$ランド$$
「Sounds like fun! So you're up for it too, huh!」

390:t_002:10.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I doubt this is a matter of good $$スフィア$$ compatibility or anything like that.」

390:t_002:11.en:
$$竜馬$$
「So that armored jerk is another hot-blooded idiot with muscle all the way up to his brain, just like $$ランド$$!」

390:t_002:13.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「We've been waiting for it, Heat Smile!」

390:t_002:15.en:
$$ラルク$$
「So these guys are the same sort, too...」

390:t_002:16.en:
$$ランド$$
「$$ストラウス$$! I received your declaration of war!」

390:t_002:18.en:
$$オットー$$
「Honestly! That man, letting the enemy provoke him!」

390:t_002:19.en:
$$レイアム$$
「What are your orders, Captain?」

390:t_002:20.en:
$$オットー$$
「Naturally, we accept the challenge! Since they're coming at us head-on, clever tricks are pointless!」

390:t_002:21.en:
$$レイアム$$
(Is it because of the break? The Captain has grown quite unflappable, but...)

390:t_002:22.en:
$$オットー$$
「The enemy will force a fleet battle! We'll dive in close and take them out one by one!」

390:t_002:23.en:
$$ランド$$
「Bring it, $$ストラウス$$! If you're coming at me with brute force, I'll overpower you with brute force!!」

390:t_003:0.en:
$$シャア$$
「Impressive, Supreme Commander of the Empire's forces...! Precise command!」

390:t_003:1.en:
$$レイアム$$
「The enemy is concentrating their attacks on this $$ネェル・アーガマ$$!」

390:t_003:2.en:
$$オットー$$
「I can tell that just by looking...!」
